name: ibis Styles Singapore Albert
short_description: A 172-room design-economy hotel on Albert Street, steps from Rochor MRT, with a rooftop pool and compact 14-16 sqm rooms.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Singapore Albert is a 172-room design-economy hotel at 175 Albert Street, steps from Rochor MRT and within walking distance of Bugis, Little India, and Arab Street. Rooms run compact at 14-16 square metres with vibrant, locally-inspired interiors, and the hotel's rooftop pool is repeatedly singled out by guests as long enough for real laps and a genuine highlight rather than a token feature. Reviews consistently praise the central location and friendly, efficient front-desk service, while a recurring theme is that rooms and bathrooms feel tight for the rate, breakfast seating gets cramped at peak times, and some fixtures (TVs, shower curtains) show their age.

elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: Steps from Rochor MRT, with easy access to Bugis, Orchard Road, and Little India
Rooftop pool that guests repeatedly call a genuine highlight, long enough for real swimming
172 individually furnished rooms with vibrant, locally-inspired design
Friendly, efficient front-desk and check-in service noted across reviews
Walking distance to Haji Lane, Arab Street, and Kuan Yin Thong Hood Cho Temple
cons: Rooms run compact at 14-16 sqm, tight even by ibis Styles standards, especially at full rate
Some guests report dated fixtures (smart TV/Wi-Fi glitches, thin shower curtains) and a spartan gym
research_highlights: The Rochor MRT-adjacent location is the most consistent praise point across guest reviews
Accor's official page shows an ALL Rating of 4.4/5 from 287 reviews, while TripAdvisor shows a lower aggregate (3/5) from around 1,208 reviews -- a notable spread worth flagging to readers
The rooftop pool is repeatedly called out as unusually good for a budget-tier hotel
research_watchouts: TripAdvisor's aggregate score (3/5) is meaningfully lower than Accor's own ALL Rating (4.4/5); both are reported here rather than picking one
A dated blog review (Aug 2023) flagged a malfunctioning smart TV, a leaking shower curtain, and a spartan gym with only three machines -- unclear if since addressed

faqs.question: How far is ibis Styles Singapore Albert from Rochor MRT station?
faqs.answer: The hotel is just steps from Rochor MRT station, giving guests direct access to Singapore's Downtown Line. From there, Bugis, Little India, and Orchard Road are all a few MRT stops or a short walk away, and the hotel itself sits within walking distance of Haji Lane and Arab Street.

faqs.question: Does ibis Styles Singapore Albert have a swimming pool?
faqs.answer: Yes, the hotel has a rooftop swimming pool that guest reviews consistently call a highlight, noting it's long enough for actual laps rather than just a plunge pool. The property also has a small fitness room, though reviewers describe the gym equipment as fairly basic.

reviews.title: ibis Styles Singapore Albert Review
reviews.summary: A Singapore blogger calls the Superior room cozy but clean, praises the rooftop pool as genuinely swimmable, but flags a malfunctioning smart TV, a leaking shower curtain, and a spartan three-machine gym.
